title: RÖDALM frame
description: RÖDALM frame, birch effect, 8x10" Decorate with pictures you love. RÖDALM frame has a modern look that does your favorite motifs justice. Place the picture in the front or back of the frame – or buy several and combine as you like. Front protection in plastic makes the frame safer to use.
features: This frame fits with a picture that has dimensions 5⅛x7⅛" if you use it with the mat, and it fits with a picture that has dimensions 7⅞x9⅞" if you choose to use the frame without the mat.
The mat will not turn yellow since it is acid-free.
Screws for wall mounting not included. Different wall materials require different fixing devices, use devices suitable for your walls. recommends ALFTA adhesive hook.
materialAndCare: Mat: Paper; Frame: Fiberboard, Paper foil; Front protection/ Inside frame: Polystyrene
